provenance.buildNote: Built — single-threaded wasi-sdk cross-compile (clang, wasi-sdk 24) of the single upstream FastTree.c (v2.2.0), no CLI wrapper (FastTree.c has its own main(): FASTA alignment on stdin → Newick on stdout). Scalar path -DNO_SSE; single-thread (omit -DOPENMP, so <omp.h> stays off); default double-precision (USE_SSE3 never set, <xmmintrin.h> stays off). One source patch (P1): rewrote `#include <malloc.h>` to `#include <stdlib.h>` since wasi-sysroot has no <malloc.h> (the include was already guarded by #ifdef TRACK_MEMORY, which we never define, but the rewrite is defensive). No other patches needed — FastTree.c uses only stdio/stdlib/string/math/ctype, <sys/time.h> (gettimeofday) and <unistd.h> (isatty), all provided by wasi-sdk; mallinfo usage is behind #ifdef TRACK_MEMORY. libc+libm only; wasm-opt -Oz + strip. Smoke test: wasm output matches the native-captured golden byte-for-byte. Dual fact: FastTree.c grants GPL-2.0-or-later (version 2 … or (at your option) any later version); repo LICENSE is GPLv3 (a permitted later version); recorded as GPL-2.0-or-later.
